fusions.name: Drawn Taut, Let Fly
fusions.desc: Looses an arm at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Harpoon at Full Stretch
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second draw, shoots an arm tip that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and stays fastened to it, leaving it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Slack Paid Out
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Cocked Arms
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
